test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.

A part / of a / apple is / rotten.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the article** "a"** before the term** "apple."**
 
• The correct article to use before** "apple" is "an," not "a."**
 
• The correct phrase should be** "of an apple,"** ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A part** of an **apple is rotten."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1: "A part" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 3: "apple is" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "rotten." **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
